UKHC010086272026
CLCON No.293 of 2026
Shubhra Mahant ………Petitioner
Vs.
Mukesh Sharma and another ………Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sagar Kothari, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. This contempt petition has been filed under Section 12 
of The Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 alleging willful and 
deliberate contempt of this Court’s order dated 22.12.2025, 
passed in WPMS No.3551 of 2025, Smt. Shubhra Mahant Vs. 
Smt. Mukesh Sharma and others, whereby this Court has 
directed the respondents-defendants not to create any third 
party interest in respect of the property in-question.
3. It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner 
that the respondents-contemnors are in full knowledge of 
the aforesaid order as copy of the said order was filed by the 
petitioner along with an application in the trial court.
4. Despite full knowledge of the order a part of subject 
matter of the case-property, was sold by the respondents￾contemnors through a registered sale deed on 12.02.2026 in 
favour of one Kamal Kant Garg.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this is 
deliberate contempt of this Court’s order dated 22.12.2025.
6. This Court prima facie finds the submission of learned 
counsel for the petitioner to be correct.
7. Issue notice to the respondents-contemnors returnable 
within six weeks.
8. Steps to be taken within three days.
9. List this case on 22.09.2026. 2
10. In the meantime, respondents-contemnors may file 
response or comply with the order. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 20.07.2026
SK
